verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say you can use existing designs to generate an app. You paste frames and components into the chat, attach several designs, or attach Figma frames via 'Add context'. Make then builds a code-backed app from them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how faithfully designs are implemented, documentation on importing whole Figma files versus individual frames.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: To use your existing designs to generate an app, click **+**, then **Add context**.
You can also paste frames and components from your designs directly into the chat.
You can attach more than one design to help give the model more guidance.
attach Figma frames, PDFs, and more
